messages:
tia: heads up — seeing spike of apiserver 503s in eu-west1 since 04:12 UTC, coincides with control-plane egress queue growth :rotating_light:
sam: pulling metrics now — etcd leader rx latency up, leader heartbeat p90 jumped to ~2.3s
sre-bot: [ALERT] apiserver-503s eu-west1 (alert_id: CP-5043) — triggered 04:13:01
jason: grabbing controller-manager / lease metrics + apiserver logs, paste in a sec
jason: ```
controller_manager_lease_queue_length 312
apiserver_request_latency_seconds_bucket{le="1"} 0.12
apiserver_request_latency_seconds_bucket{le="5"} 0.67
etcd_network_send_duration_seconds_sum 1.8
```
maria: any infra changes around 04:00-04:10?
tanvi: we rolled out proxy egress throttling (PR #442) at 03:58 — limits concurrent outbound SYNs to 200 to cut NAT costs
alex: PR also adjusted HTTP keepalive header batching, might affect connection reuse across control-plane proxies
sam: hypothesis: proxy throttle + keepalive tweak -> conn churn -> increased apiserver fanout latency -> leader heartbeat delays
oncall: testing a config bump now — temporary increase ephemeral port pool + conn limit from 200 -> 800 in eu-west1, will observe for 5m
tia: logs show repeated `failed to stream watch: net/http: timeout awaiting response` and `lease renewal delayed` around 04:14
jason: kube-system pod list (snapshot):
```
NAME                                  READY   STATUS    RESTARTS
kube-apiserver-eu-west1-0             1/1     Running   2
kube-controller-manager-eu-west1-0    1/1     Running   0
etcd-eu-west1-0                       1/1     Running   0
```
maria: can we just rollback PR #442? it was to save NAT costs but this is affecting control plane
tanvi: rollback has broader impact and needs cross-region approval, prefer temp bump to validate hypothesis
oncall: bumped ephemeral ports to 800 and removed aggressive SYN throttle at 04:18, clearing stale connections now
sre-bot: [INFO] proxy-conn-utilization eu-west1 -> 0.18 at 04:20
sam: after bump p95 leader heartbeat dropped back to ~120ms, apiserver 503s subsided
tia: confirming latencies and lease queue cleared — looks stable. opening infra ticket infra#789 for follow-up and PR rework
alex: note on cost tradeoff: larger ephemeral allocations increase NAT session churn; rough estimate +$120/day for eu-west1 with current traffic pattern, propose a dedicated control-plane NAT or reserved path for control traffic
maria: filing changelog + runbook update for oncall to have port-bump steps and rollback guidance
sre-bot: [RESOLVED] apiserver-503s eu-west1 (alert_id: CP-5043) at 04:28
